name: Moledo
note: Sandbanks off the Minho mouth, lefts and rights, very consistent. Strong rips and some rock, quiet weekdays, packed summer weekends. All levels.
cam_shows: Afife (Arda) beach, 8 km south. No camera at Moledo.

name: Afife (Arda)
note: Best-rated beach break in the Minho, lefts and rights, holds 2 m+, very consistent, busy when on. All levels, surf school on the sand.
cam_shows: Afife / Arda beach (feed showed 'not available' on 2026-09-07)

name: Viana – Cabedelo
note: City beach south of the Lima river mole; the jetty cleans up north wind and holds sandbanks. Quiet weekdays, crowded weekends, all levels, mostly flat in summer.
cam_shows: Cabedelo beach with live surf report

name: Ofir
note: Sandbars over rock in front of the hotel, rights by the pier, lefts along the rocks, holds 4 m+. Rips, localism, experienced surfers preferred.

name: Leça da Palmeira
note: Urban beach north of the Leixões breakwater; the wall blocks south wind and swell. Barrels on offshore mornings, crowded weekends, currents by the dock. All levels.

name: Matosinhos
note: Porto's town beach inside the Leixões breakwater; the wall halves the swell so it works when everything else is closed out. Very crowded, water quality after rain. All levels.
cam_shows: Praia de Matosinhos with surf report

name: Espinho (Baía)
note: Beach break between rock groynes, the closest reliable wave south of Porto; hollow lefts and rights with real power on bigger days. Rips along the jetties, fishing lines. All levels.

name: Furadouro
note: Open beach with several peaks, mostly lefts, fast and occasionally hollow, best at 1 to 1.5 m and messy above 2 m. Rocks in the line-up. All levels.

name: Praia da Barra
note: Sandbar against the Aveiro south jetty, needs size to start and then holds 4 m+. Rips, learner-friendly on small days, crowded weekends.

cam_alts.shows: São Jacinto side of the jetty

name: Costa Nova
note: Open beach with groynes 2 km south of Barra, fairly consistent, picks up more swell than Barra and closes out sooner. Rips. All levels.
